freshPreparation.issuer: Private actual FIRST checkpoint2 issuer, associated with current actual Main/frame and retained through real corrected Ready; never a caller flag, JSON field or recreated cache capability.
freshPreparation.consumption: Consume one-shot preparation permission at first I preparation START, before I reads/projector/UTC. Any later failure is sticky for this owner; absent durable result is not permission to reacquire/recompute.
freshPreparation.noResultRestart: Absent capability after process loss or disposal plus checkpoint2/missing result => HELD. Do not upgrade checkpoint1 or rewrite/reseed Ready.
freshPreparation.earlyFailureOwner: Typed hold/destructive-fallback protection must cover the precommon I phase before the existing common publisher is entered; callback success or current bytes cannot mask owning release/outer finalization failure.
freshPreparation.errorResult: Retain an exact Error-bearing computed result; no no-Error common admission, generic repair replacement, Ready reseed or automatic re-projection. Whole-vertical implementation must explicitly place that held disposition before any automatic continuation rather than infer success from storage.

reconstruction.prepared: A newly admitted current Main/lease/physical graph owner can finish publishing only the stored result bytes; it cannot recreate the original preparation permission, old Stage/Ready/capture owner or historical public return.
reconstruction.published: Current stable recovery and exact image/link proof authorize a DATA view, not an old returned-I event. Actual new reader/adapter return and its owning release are transient observations.
reconstruction.common: Requires NEW actual original/checkpoint/request/claim/mechanical/common/take owners. Stored ordinals are history, not live capabilities. Failure to obtain current owners holds; no fallback normalization or synthetic authority.
